maps.name: Bio-based pathways global map
maps.description:
# Hotspot products and their bio-based pathways A graph database representing bio-based alternative pathways to high-greenhouse-gas-footprint petrochemicals in the European Union. Share link: https://kumu.io/nicolas-lienart/screenlca-paper-biobased-pathways Author: [Nicolas LIENART](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-3259-2819) ## Legend Diamonds represent processes interconnecting products, represented by circles. A complete legend is located in the bottom left corner. ## Metadata Nodes contain some metadata listed below. For more details, please refer to the related scientific publication, including its supplementary materials and code. ### Products: - `Available quantity in the EU27 in 2022 (Mt)`: This accounts both production + imports, expressed in million tonnes of product per year - `HS 2022 codes`: 6-digit Harmonized System (HS) 2022 codes - `Hotspot rank`: Priority rank of the product, based on its total footprint, ranking is performed by descending order of total footprint - `PRODCOM classification`: Associated PRODCOM product, there could be multiple matching products when the hotspot product has been aggregated. - `Total GHG footprint of the available quantity in the EU27 in 2022 (Mt CO2-eq)`: Indicates the greenhouse gas (GHG) footprint of the product, related to the available quantity. It uses the GWP100 indicator based on characterization factors of the IPCC 2021 report. ### Processes: - `Maturity score`: Possible options are either "Low", "Medium", "High" or "Fully mature". See article supplementary materials's PDF Table S6 for more details. - `Maturity score references`: Any bibliographic reference whiched helped to determine the process' maturity - `Process references`: Any bibliographic reference giving some details about the process ## Related publication - Title: Residual biomass to bio-based chemicals and plastics: ex-ante screening methodology for prioritizing high-impact substitutions - Authors: [Nicolas LIENART](https://orcid.org/0009-0001-3259-2819), [Thibaut LECOMPTE](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9237-8454), [Lorie HAMELIN](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9092-1900) - Journal: Resources, Conservation and Recycling (RCR) - Elsevier - Doi: #todo - Git repository (Forge INRAE): https://forge.inrae.fr/nicolas.lienart/screen-lca-paper-supplementary-code - Git repository (GitHub): https://github.com/nicolnt/screen-lca-paper-supplementary-code ## Licence If may freely utilize any portion of this database or the associated materials, the only requirement is to give proper credit by properly citing the related publication.
